method: Read only audit of native public message and tool events, frozen input metadata, immutable plan and accounting. Exact quote spans are checked against attached snapshot identity; model-proposed support and citation admissibility are not semantic verification. No inference or provider requests.

accounting.rooms: Development cancel 2 model / 0 tool; integration source-summary 23 / 23 and market-context 16 / 16. 41 model / 39 tool total. Two cancelled calls have unknown usage; token totals are reported amounts, not complete totals.

source_summary_audit.outcome: Did not produce the requested useful primary-source summary. 12 public messages, 23 tool admissions (6 news searches, 1 artifact search, 16 room-message attempts), 23 model admissions; room terminated abstention.

known_inputs.title: Extension of timeline with respect to compliance of Digital Accessibility Circulars
Coal India Marks 51 Glorious Years with Record-Breaking Performance in October 2026

source_summary_audit.facts_and_limits: SEBI saved title is date-only 2026-10-30 with feed metadata and no retained article body. PIB Coal India saved title has unknown publication date and cannot be placed in a window; feed metadata only for this frozen record. Neither is mapped to an issuer; the title is not independent verification of its contents or a company filing.
source_summary_audit.failed_searches: Skeptic used literal topic strings Accessibility SEBI and Coal India PIB, both empty; source labels became part of topic matching rather than source filters. Analyst made four denied searches with end after cutoff. No news evidence was returned to the room.
source_summary_audit.unsupported_and_repetition: At seq 44 skeptic incorrectly says analyst searches were not denied; seq 53 analyst accepts this incorrect correction. Seq 136 incorrectly concludes no relevant facts are available in saved records; frozen inputs show two relevant saved titles. Seq 105 and 114 cite only the internal heading Personal Kepler Research Revamp, which cannot substantiate regulatory absence or source health. Several turns repeat empty-result and metadata assertions; the final seq 149 abstains. Feed-window absence itself cannot prove no release.

market_context_audit.outcome: 12 public messages, 16 tool admissions (4 market_context reads, 12 room-message attempts), 16 model admissions; status abstention, termination message_limit. No numerical quote or opening-gap assertion in public messages.
market_context_audit.useful: All three saved quotes are unavailable and null; GIFT contract and expiry unresolved, and none has a quote exchange timestamp or known delay. A numerical comparison requires identified compatible quotes, times, references and a resolved GIFT contract. The saved STI observation separately labels its calculation session open, subject to partial calendar qualification; the requested-cutoff assessment is also open in the actual returned packets. Neither unavailable quote nor an unverified provider proves the market is closed or entitlement impossible.
market_context_audit.citations: 11 of 12 public messages cite spans, all from market:nifty_cash. Seq 23 and 40 use the Nifty cash null quote span for GIFT assertions; seq 49 uses NIFTY cash instrument identity for GIFT. Seq 58 and 112 mark claims as model-proposed supported but cite only NIFTY 50 cash index / NSE, insufficient to establish GIFT future / NSEIX or contract details. Citation admissibility validates a span reference, not the narrative.
market_context_audit.unsupported_and_repetition: Skeptic at seq 67 and 121 asserts no quote entitlement exists; verification is absent, not proof of no entitlement. Seq 85, 103 and 121 claim no observable market state exists, despite saved STI session marked open (with caveat), and conflate no quote with no market state. The participants repeatedly debate metadata usefulness without developing an STI analysis; seq 32 calls the room cutoff a snapshot time though observations were received earlier.
market_context_audit.packet_quality: MarketEvidence packets are derived_market_observation_summary with packet status ok, while embedded snapshot status is unavailable and quote null; status ok describes packet, not quote. Saved source and market-state fields remain visible. There is no automatic trading or model price calculation in this audit. Do not present the packet as an exchange quotation.

limitations: This is a narrative and provenance audit of these saved runs, not verification of live market, provider entitlements, publication text, or external truth.
Availability metadata represents what the service recorded by the cutoff; labels do not prove current contract resolution or market data rights.
Model-proposed supported/insufficient labels and valid quote IDs do not establish that claims are entailed by cited spans.
